search_text: published ZDI-13-268 ZDI-CAN-1772 ABB MicroSCADA Wserver wserver.exe Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-11-24 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['ABB'] ['MicroSCADA'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ABB MicroSCADA Wserver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the wserver.exe component which listens on TCP port 12221. This component performs insufficient bounds checking on user-supplied data which results in stack corruption. An attacker can leverage this situation to execute code under the context of the user running the application. ABB has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www05.abb.com/global/scot/scot229.nsf/veritydisplay/41ccfa8ccd0431e6c1257c1200395574/$file/ABB_SoftwareVulnerabilityHandlingAdvisory_ABB-VU-PSAC-1MRS235805.pdf ['2013-02-13 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2013-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-13-268/
title: ABB MicroSCADA Wserver wserver.exe Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ABB MicroSCADA Wserver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the wserver.exe component which listens on TCP port 12221. This component performs insufficient bounds checking on user-supplied data which results in stack corruption. An attacker can leverage this situation to execute code under the context of the user running the application.
